python_lint_scope.meaning: Exclude experiments/ and docs/ (archived name-handling evidence and recorded artefacts, some digest-pinned) from PY_FILES / the python lint gate; format and fix real tooling (including scripts/dev and bigip-probes) so it passes ruff.

tclvm_default_constructors.meaning: Vm::new()/Vm::with_output() do not get an implicit native core. Every test harness and embedder constructs interpreters with Vm::with_native_core(...) and an explicit profile; Vm::new becomes test-only or is removed so no caller can build an interpreter that refuses every command name.
